files.compact-ui.js: (()=>{const body=document.body;const home=document.getElementById("compactHome");if(!home)return;const by=id=>document.getElementById(id);body.classList.add("cb-compact");function open(view){if(body.classList.contains("session-active")||body.classList.contains("reader-mode"))return;if(view==="more"){const m=by("neonMore");if(m){m.open=!m.open;if(m.open)m.scrollIntoView({block:"nearest"});}return;}if(view==="home"){if(body.classList.contains("review-ready")){body.dataset.cbView="setup";by("sessionReview")?.scrollIntoView({block:"start"});return;}refreshPrep();body.dataset.cbView="home";window.scrollTo(0,0);return;}body.dataset.cbView="setup";let target=by("setupPanel");if(view==="profile")target=by("domain")||target;if(view==="docs"||view==="cvdoc"||view==="jobdoc"){target=view==="cvdoc"?by("cvFile"):view==="jobdoc"?by("jobFile"):document.querySelector("#setupPanel .context-panel");target=target?.closest(".context-field")||target||by("setupPanel");}if(view==="settings"){const a=document.querySelector("#setupPanel .advanced");if(a){a.open=true;target=a;}}if(view==="report"){if(body.classList.contains("review-ready"))target=by("sessionReview");else{target=document.querySelector("#setupPanel .review-consent")||target;}}requestAnimationFrame(()=>{target?.scrollIntoView({block:"start",behavior:"instant"});});}document.querySelectorAll("[data-cb-view]").forEach(el=>el.addEventListener("click",()=>open(el.dataset.cbView)));function refreshPrep(){for(const [key,id] of [["cv","compactCv"],["job","compactJob"]]){const b=by(id),s=by(key+"Status"),badge=by(key+"ReadyBadge");if(!b||!s)continue;const ready=s.dataset.state==="ready"&&!!by(key+"Text")?.value.trim();const allowed=!!by("docConsent")?.checked;b.classList.toggle("prep-ready",ready);if(badge)badge.hidden=!ready;const label=(key==="cv"?"CV":"İş tanımı")+(ready?(allowed?" yüklendi":" yüklendi · kullanım onayı gerekli"):" yükle");b.setAttribute("aria-label",label);b.title=label;}}const ob=new MutationObserver(refreshPrep);for(const key of ["cv","job"]){const s=by(key+"Status");if(s)ob.observe(s,{attributes:true,attributeFilter:["data-state"],childList:true,subtree:true});}by("docConsent")?.addEventListener("change",refreshPrep);for(const key of ["cv","job"]){by(key+"Text")?.addEventListener("input",refreshPrep);by(key+"File")?.addEventListener("change",refreshPrep);by(key+"Clear")?.addEventListener("click",refreshPrep);}window.addEventListener("pageshow",refreshPrep);by("pwaMenuTrigger")?.addEventListener("click",()=>{const b=document.querySelector(".pwa-install");if(b&&!b.hidden)b.click();else{const n=by("pwaMenuTrigger");if(n)n.textContent="Uygulama zaten yüklü veya yükleme kullanılamıyor";}});refreshPrep();body.dataset.cbView=location.hash==="#setupPanel"||location.hash==="#livePanel"?"setup":"home";window.addEventListener("hashchange",()=>{if(location.hash==="#setupPanel"||location.hash==="#livePanel")open("setup")});})();
